family.$description: RN font family names. Each weight is a distinct linked family (the licensed Fatype OTFs ship one file per weight), so components set fontFamily directly rather than relying on fontWeight mapping. See docs/foundations/typography.md for linking.

display.$description: Make Way — display serif. The book uses ONE weight only: 'Do not use other weights of Make Way' (p32).

display-app.$description: Make Way App — screen-optimized display cut

sans.$description: Beausite Classic — body/UI. Book uses Light, Regular, Semibold only (p33).

sans-medium.$description: CTA weight. The book's hierarchy names 'Beausite Classic Medium' for CTAs (p34) even though its weight page lists Light/Regular/Semibold — see $notes.

sans-app.$description: Screen-optimized sans cut for dense UI

text.$description: Mobile type scale, DERIVED FROM the Alix Brand Guidelines (Jan 2026) 'Typography → Hierarchy' (p34). The book specifies ratios, not pixels, so every entry here is computed from its font size and the stated ratio rather than hand-set. fontSize / lineHeight / letterSpacing are absolute points (RN-ready).
text.$notes: The book's stated rules, and how they land here: HEADLINES — Make Way Regular, sentence case, line spacing 105–115%, tracking −2%. BODY — Beausite Classic Regular, sentence case, line spacing 125–135%, tracking 0%. EYEBROW — Beausite Classic Regular, all-caps, tracking 0%. CTA — Beausite Classic Medium, title case, tracking 0%. NUMERALS — Make Way Regular. Two deliberate departures, both flagged: (1) the eyebrow keeps a small positive tracking (+4%) because at 11pt all-caps in a UI, 0% tracking is genuinely hard to read — the book's specimen is set far larger; (2) Make Way carries no fontWeight override, since the book permits exactly one weight. An earlier version of this file set body at 150% line spacing, eyebrow at +8% tracking, and Make Way at weight 500 — none of which the book supports.

display.$description: Hero headline or number — one per screen. 109% / −2%.

numeral.$description: Figures set in Make Way per the book's Numerals rule (p34); tracking 0%, unlike headlines.

body-strong.$description: Emphasis within body — Semibold, a weight the book sanctions.

section.$description: Section header in a list or form. 129% / 0%.

eyebrow.$description: All-caps label ABOVE a headline — the book's Eyebrow (p34). Regular weight, not Medium. Use sparingly: it is an eyebrow, not a style for every card label.

button.$description: CTA label — Beausite Classic Medium, Title Case, tracking 0% (p34).
